notes.title: ABYA: Paint Ball exhibits new version prologue at WePlay Expo 2024!
notes.notes:
Dear players, we have been waiting for a long time. ABYA will bring its new version of the demo level to the WePlay Expo 2024 held on 11.16-11.17! You can experience the newly optimized opening chapter of this demo, and the challenge experience will be greatly improved! There are also peripheral gifts on site!
Booth Location: S05 Hit Academy Booth

notes.title: Next Fest Version stop updated,the editor and official version coming soon!
notes.notes:
Dear ABYA:Paint Ball players:

Steam Next Fest has officially ended, and we would like to thank everyone who participated in the trial! It is your enthusiasm and valuable opinions that have allowed us to recognize the many shortcomings of the game and address them in a timely manner.

The development team has already entered the development phase of the official version of ABYA:Paint Ball. We will continue to spare no effort in optimizing the game mechanics, improving the graphics quality and adding other details, and we look forward to bringing you an unforgettable adventure.

In addition, the development of the new version of the editor is also in the final stage, and it will be ready to meet you soon. Every player will be able to use the editor to create unique game worlds - whether it's a more challenging level, or a gripping story - and you're all welcome to try it out!

Last but not least, stay tuned to ABYA:Paint Ball as we continue to make updates. If you have any suggestions you can give us feedback by joining our community.

Sincerely, Pone Games Team
